question: Should Vault be bundled in OpenClaw core as a maintained reference SecretRef exec provider, or remain an installable ClawHub/GitHub plugin using the existing plugin-managed exec seam?
rationale: Root policy routes optional provider integrations to plugins/ClawHub when the seam is sufficient, while this PR adds a bundled credential and network-exec trust boundary plus dependency/package ownership.

options.title: Bundle After Repair And Approval
options.body: Fix the parser and SDK budget issues, clear dependency/security review, and land Vault as a maintained bundled reference plugin.

options.title: Keep Vault External
options.body: Close or redirect the PR if maintainers prefer the existing external `claw-vault`/ClawHub path instead of core ownership.

options.title: Hold For Sponsor
options.body: Keep the PR open but require an explicit maintainer and security sponsor before more contributor work is requested.

recommendation.title: Bundle After Repair And Approval
recommendation.body: Fix the parser and SDK budget issues, clear dependency/security review, and land Vault as a maintained bundled reference plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed Vault implementation and the related SecretRef provider integration contract, though secops approval remains required.
